intro: One letter, one category, and 15 seconds to make your mark.
homeMessage: People often say technology pulls families apart and gradually replaces real moments together. This game was created to do exactly the opposite: turn technology into a reason to get together, laugh, challenge one another, make memories, and strengthen the bonds between family and friends.
rule1: Everyone gets the same category and a randomly selected letter.
rule2: Write your answer before STOP. It stays secret until time runs out.
rule3: Vote on everyone else’s answers, then see the scores.
scoring: A valid answer earns 10 points, or 5 for a duplicate. First to 200 wins!
lobbyText: Share the code, gather your family and start the first round.
waitingHost: The host will start the round.
needPlayers: At least 2 connected players are needed to start.
leaveText: You won’t be able to reclaim this seat. Your points will stay on the scoreboard.
notSaved: Answer not saved. Try again before STOP.
privateAnswer: Your answer stays secret until STOP.
pressEnter: Press Enter to save your answer.
stopText: Answers are locked. Time to judge!
strictReason: Left the screen: 0 points in strict mode
votesPending: Waiting for votes. Voting can close after 30 seconds.
tiesPending: Resolve tied votes before showing results.
resultsText: This round’s points have been awarded.
winnerText: A great game deserves a rematch.
tiebreak: A tie at the top! Time for another round.
sessionReplaced: This seat is being used in another tab.
soundBlocked: Enable sound using the button at the top.
stayFocused: Stay on this screen during the round.
softHelp: Leaving the screen is logged without a penalty.
normalHelp: Leaving the screen is flagged during judging.
strictHelp: Leaving the screen while answering disqualifies your answer.
tieHelp: The host breaks ties. Another player decides ties on the host’s own answer.
spectating: You’ll play in the next round.
waitingResults: Waiting for the host to show results.
chatEmpty: No messages yet. Start the conversation!
leaveFailed: Unable to leave. Try again once reconnected.

error.not_found: Room not found. Check the code.

error.host_only: Only the host can do that.
error.need_players: At least 2 connected players are needed.
error.answer_closed: Time is up. Your last saved answer has been kept.
error.invalid_letters: Choose at least two different letters.
